packageRules.description: Go module dependencies (backend/go.mod require block). The go directive itself is intentionally left alone by Renovate's default behavior.
tailwindcss updates are excluded from the shared npm-dependencies group so they never block unrelated package updates from merging

Node runtime version (.nvmrc) — single source of truth for the Node version used everywhere
Node/Go Dockerfile ARGs are driven exclusively by .nvmrc/go.mod (see nvm/gomod rules above), not by independent Docker tag lookups, to avoid two diverging sources of truth for the same version
